fullDescription: A high-end luxury dark-mode design system characterized by a 'Gold and Obsidian' palette. It features editorial typography pairing the elegant Zodiak serif with the modern Satoshi sans-serif. Ideal for premium automotive, high-end real estate, luxury retail, or VIP membership portals. The design uses sophisticated micro-interactions like shimmer effects, grain textures, and gold gradients to convey exclusivity. The layout is optimized for mobile-first editorial storytelling with deep shadows, radial gold glows, and minimalist decorative elements like thin separators and crown iconography.
prompt:
## Resumo
An elite, dark-themed editorial design system for luxury brands. It utilizes a sophisticated gold-on-black aesthetic, combining cinematic scale with fine typographic details, grain textures, and fluid entrance animations to create a sense of prestige and rarity.

## Estilo Visual
Apply a 'Gold and Obsidian' luxury aesthetic. Background: solid #050505 with a subtle #0a0a0a noise overlay (opacity: 0.15) and a central radial glow of #BF953F (opacity: 20%). Primary Typography: 'Zodiak' (Serif) for headlines; 'Satoshi' (Sans-serif) for body and labels. Accent Colors: Gold gradient (linear-gradient: #BF953F, #FCF6BA, #B38728, #FBF5B7, #AA771C). UI Elements: Use ultra-thin borders (rgba(255,255,255,0.05)), high tracking (0.4em) for uppercase tags, and soft drop shadows (0 25px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.8)). Animations: Implement cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for all entrance transitions including fadeInDown and scaleIn.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Container & Background
Create a centered mobile-view container (375px x 812px) with rounded corners (40px) and a subtle 1px border of white/5. Behind all content, place a large 'watermark' text (e.g., '2024') in Zodiak Bold at the bottom, opacity 20%, scale 150px, pointer-events: none.

### Header
Top-aligned section. Include a 48px horizontal thin divider with a gold gradient. Below it, a label in Satoshi Bold, 10px size, 0.4em tracking, uppercase, color #BF953F.

### Hero Content
Center-aligned stack. Headline 1: Zodiak Serif, uppercase, tracking-widest, color white/80, 18px. Headline 2 (The Focus): Zodiak Bold, 72px, gold gradient text-clip, tracking-tighter. Subheadline: Satoshi Italic, 20px, color #BF953F. Below text, place a large high-fidelity product image with a 4:5 aspect ratio, featuring a soft radial pulse glow behind it and a blurred elliptical shadow beneath it.

### Features & Narrative
A narrative block featuring a crown icon (Lucide: crown) in #BF953F flanked by two thin 32px horizontal lines. Below this, a body paragraph in Satoshi, 14px, #A3A3A3 (Neutral-400), max-width 280px, line-height 1.6.

### Footer CTA & Socials
Primary CTA: A full-width button with a gold gradient background (#BF953F to #AA771C) featuring a 'shimmer' animation (a white light streak moving 45 degrees across the button). Text in Satoshi Bold, black, uppercase, 14px. Below the button, a row of social icons (Instagram, Globe, Share) in #737373, transitioning to #BF953F on hover.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Shimmering Gold Button — A high-gloss button with a moving light reflection.
Create a button with a background gradient (#BF953F to #AA771C). Overlay a pseudo-element with a linear-gradient (45deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.1), transparent). Animate the pseudo-element to slide from -100% to 100% position over 3 seconds infinitely. Ensure text is black and tracking-widest.

### Gold Gradient Text — Multi-stop metallic text effect.
Implement text using background-clip: text. Use linear-gradient(to right, #BF953F 0%, #FCF6BA 25%, #B38728 50%, #FBF5B7 75%, #AA771C 100%). Set -webkit-text-fill-color to transparent.

## Notas Especiais
MUST use the noise texture to prevent 'flat' digital looks. MUST maintain high letter-spacing (tracking) for all uppercase Satoshi text to preserve the luxury feel. MUST NOT use vibrant colors outside the gold/black spectrum. Animations must be staggered: header at 0ms, hero at 200ms, body and footer at 700ms.
